panel.title: Mod groups
panel.intro: A group keeps mods that belong together in one fixed load order, whoever made them. Every admin of this panel sees the same groups.
panel.applyDisabledInOrder: Every group is already in order.
panel.applyDisabledDirty: Save or reset your unsaved order changes first. Applying works on the saved load order.
panel.applyDisabledBusy: Wait until the load order has been saved.
panel.noPermission: Your role does not have permission to manage mods.
panel.loadFailed: Mod groups could not be loaded.
panel.emptyDesc: Group mods that must load in a fixed order, such as a vehicle pack: its library first, then the core mods, then the add-ons, and the fixes last. The panel keeps that order whenever you save the load order.
panel.conflicts: Some groups contradict each other, so no load order can satisfy all of them. Involved: {{items}}
panel.enforceLabel: Keep group order when saving the load order
panel.enforceDesc: When on, saving the load order moves group members back into their group order.

dialog.description: A group is an ordered list of mods. Whenever the load order is saved, its members keep this order, whatever other mods sit between them.
dialog.descriptionPlaceholder: What these mods have in common
dialog.membersHint: The first mod loads first. A typical order: library → core mods → add-ons → fixes.
dialog.membersEmpty: No mods yet. Add them below, in the order they must load.
dialog.searchPlaceholder: Search the mods enabled on this server by name or ID
dialog.noMatches: No enabled mod matches your search.
dialog.allAdded: Every mod enabled on this server is already in this group.
dialog.showingFirst: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}}. Type to narrow the list.
dialog.needTwo: Add at least two mods to save the group.
dialog.saveFailedFallback: The group could not be saved.
dialog.placementHint: Libraries and frameworks first, patches and fixes last. Kept in this browser.
dialog.keepTogetherHint: The mods load as one block, where the first of them is now. Mods between them move after the block.
dialog.autoOrderDone: Ordered: requirements first, then libraries, main mods, add-ons and fixes. Check it, then save.
dialog.autoOrderUnchanged: The members are already in that order.
dialog.absentWarning_one: {{count}} member is not on this server. It keeps its place and loads once it is enabled.
dialog.absentWarning_other: {{count}} members are not on this server. They keep their place and load once they are enabled.

apply.confirmDesc_one: {{count}} mod would move so that every group is in order. The new load order is saved to the server INI.
apply.confirmDesc_other: {{count}} mods would move so that every group is in order. The new load order is saved to the server INI.
apply.conflictsNote: Some groups contradict each other ({{items}}), so they cannot all be satisfied.
apply.appliedDesc: The load order has been updated in the server INI.
apply.notWritten: The server did not write the new order.
apply.failedTitle: Could not apply the group order
apply.failedFallback: The group order could not be applied.

delete.title: Delete group "{{name}}"?
delete.description: The group is removed for every admin. Your mods and the load order are not changed.
delete.failedFallback: The group could not be deleted.

export.doneDesc: Saved as {{file}}. Import it on another panel to share the group.
export.failedFallback: The group file could not be created.

import.notJson: The file is not a JSON document.
import.wrongKind: This JSON is not a mod group export. Use a file made by Export on this page.
import.unsupportedSchema: This file was made by a different version of the panel and cannot be read here.
import.invalid: The file needs a name and a list of mod IDs.
import.tooLarge: The file is far too large to be a mod group.
import.readFailed: The file could not be read.
import.failedFallback: The group could not be imported.
import.doneDesc: "{{name}}" was added to the mod groups.

enforce.failedFallback: The setting could not be saved.

toast.orderKept_one: Group order kept: {{count}} mod was moved
toast.orderKept_other: Group order kept: {{count}} mods were moved
toast.orderKeptDesc: Saving moved mods back into their group order. The list now shows the order that was saved.
toast.orderKeptWithConflicts: Saving moved mods back into their group order. Some groups contradict each other: {{items}}
toast.conflictsDesc: No load order can satisfy all groups. Review the order of these: {{items}}

addTo.title: Add to a group
addTo.descriptionOne: Pick the group for {{name}}. It joins at the end of the group's order.
addTo.descriptionMany_one: Pick the group for {{count}} mod. It joins at the end of the group's order.
addTo.descriptionMany_other: Pick the group for {{count}} mods. They join at the end of the group's order.
addTo.noGroups: No groups yet. Start one with New group.
addTo.failedFallback: The mods could not be added to the group.
addTo.noModIds: Its mod IDs are only known once it is on the server.
addTo.pickFirst: Tick the mods to add first.

removeFrom.failedTitle: Could not remove from the group
removeFrom.failedFallback: The group could not be changed.
removeFrom.tooFew: A group needs at least two mods. Delete the group instead.

sections.allEnabled: Every mod of the group that this server has is enabled.
sections.noneEnabled: None of the group's mods is enabled.

suggestions.title: Suggested groups ({{count}})

kind.dependency_one: {{name}} and the mod that needs it

suggestions.dismissFailedFallback: The suggestion could not be dismissed. Try again.

enable.doneDesc_other: {{count}} mods were added to the server config. Restart the server to load them.
enable.nothingDesc: Every mod of {{name}} that this server has is already enabled.
enable.missingNote_one: {{count}} mod is not on this server and was skipped: {{ids}}.
enable.missingNote_other: {{count}} mods are not on this server and were skipped: {{ids}}.
enable.failedFallback: The group's mods could not be enabled.
enable.unsavedOrder: Save or discard your load order changes first: this changes the load order.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.description_one: {{count}} mod leaves the server config (Mods=). Its files stay on disk, so enabling the group again is instant.
disable.description_other: {{count}} mods leave the server config (Mods=). Their files stay on disk, so enabling the group again is instant.
disable.sharedNote: Kept, because another group that is fully enabled needs them: {{items}}
disable.failedFallback: The group's mods could not be disabled.
